pieces.title: Cast skins
pieces.caption: Three pages that wore one face for weeks or months and then grew another: STIGMERGY, The Lens, FOUR PILLARS. The old hero is faded on the left, the one worn now on the right. The old ones are still whole, in git. *What is real and what is a choice:* Read from git history. A challenger counted 26 hero files that have ever changed; I picked three that changed in place after a long wear. Calling a replaced hero a cast skin is my analogy: the page's sentence is about a person's public archive. *Leaking in:* STIGMERGY, The Lens and FOUR PILLARS lend their old faces.
pieces.near: A public archive is a trail of cast skins
